fields.narration: STARTEX. This is an exercise. It is 09:15 on Tuesday, October 13, 2026, a clear autumn morning in Marlow Falls, and Halvorsen State University's four research buildings are running a normal weekday, with about 40 people at work in the Lindgren Life Sciences Building. The EHS portal, badge access, freezer monitoring and HSUAlert all show normal, and there are no open incident files. For the whole exercise, any organism in play is a Risk Group 2 culture covered by an approved laboratory protocol, and HSU holds no select agents and has no BSL-3 space. Each of you: state your role and your standing orders, and confirm where your copies of the biosafety plan, the exposure plan and the communications plan are.
